findings.issue: The two order-case cards still stand in a narrow centred column (about 350–1090 px of the 1440 frame) under a heading, 'A recent order', that starts on the content's left edge, which leaves about 330 px of empty tint on each side. The cards float mid-page instead of following their heading.
findings.reference: The competitor's card sets start on the content's left edge under their heading and fill the content width (home section 7: outlined cards in a row, 1px outline, about 28 px gutter).
findings.fix: In patterns.css, stop centring `.order-cases` (max-width plus margin-inline: auto) when headings start: under `body[data-heading-align="start"]` set `.order-cases { margin-inline: 0; }`. Better still, set the cases side by side in a grid of equal columns from the left edge.

findings.issue: In the narrow left column of the two-column FAQ, 'Frequently Asked Questions' still breaks into three one-word lines, so the heading looks stacked rather than sized to its words.
findings.reference: The competitor's FAQ (home section 16) sets its heading across the width on one line, with the questions below it on hairline rows.
findings.fix: In the faq two-column layout, widen the heading column. Or, when the template's fit would leave one word per line, set the heading above the questions.

findings.issue: The timeline rows are divided by solid black 1px rules (`.process-timeline__row` uses `--border-color`, #000000), directly under the FAQ's light 18% hairlines. One tinted section ends up with two weights of rule, and the steps read as heavier than the rest of the page.
findings.reference: The competitor separates FAQ rows, table facts and timeline steps with light hairlines only, never solid black rules.
findings.fix: In reference.css set `.block--process .process-timeline__row { border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 18%, transparent); }`, the same hairline the FAQ rows and tables use.

findings.issue: On phones the six step rows are divided by solid black full-width rules, which look heavy against the light text. The same rows on desktop use the same black rule, unlike every other row list on the page.
findings.reference: The competitor's step and list rows sit over light hairlines.
findings.fix: The same change as faq-steps: an 18% hairline on `.block--process .process-timeline__row` in reference.css.

findings.issue: The open first answer is a single unbroken paragraph of about 370 words. That is about 40 lines on a phone, and a dense block in the desktop column too, covering three separate client projects, certifications and shipping terms.
findings.reference: The competitor's FAQ answers are short paragraphs under each question.
findings.fix: In Site Factory, split the answer into short paragraphs (one per project, then one for certifications, testing and shipping), or shorten it and point to the cases section.
